theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Standard health apps use clinical greens and whites. To appeal to health-conscious individuals while feeling premium and modern, we use a tactile earthy palette. This removes the 'medical' feel and introduces a mindful, empowering aesthetic.
theme_and_archetype.emotional_tone: Empowering, mindful, warm, and structured without being rigid.

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter for headings. Ensure tight letter spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em) on all headlines.
rules.hierarchy: Ensure high contrast between sizes. Pair light weight large headings with bold tiny overlines.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use 2x more padding than standard apps to create a breathable, premium feel.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use max-w-lg mx-auto for mobile views to simulate the app structure, or responsive max-w-7xl for wide views. Mobile-first layout always.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento grid approach. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
grid_system.hero_card: col-span-full md:col-span-2 row-span-2 for the calorie ring and main stats.

cards.style: Tactile Neumorphism mixed with sharp bounds. background-color: white; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); border-radius: 1.5rem;

headers.style: Optical Clarity Glassmorphism. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-black/5.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E26D5C] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-[#C95A4B] shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(226,109,92,0.3)] transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F2EFEB] text-[#1A1A1A] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-[#E8E4DF] transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.floating_action: fixed bottom-8 right-8 bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all z-40

inputs.style: bg-[#F2EFEB] border-none rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[#1A1A1A] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E26D5C] focus:bg-white transition-all outline-none

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Smooth, tactile, and natural. Reduce visual noise.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Ensure all structural motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a premium, lightweight look. Icons must vertically align perfectly with text.

images.description: Healthy breakfast bowl with fruits and granola.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. Do not use generic tailwind colors like green-500 for success elements; use the specified Sage or Terracotta.
Implement the 'Bento' grid structure for the dashboard using responsive grid columns.
Ensure the calorie ring and macro charts use the exact colors specified in colors.charts.
Use Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, forms, and tabs, but override their default styles to match the 'cards' and 'buttons' styling definitions (sharp bounds, organic shadows, earthy background).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case for automated testing.
Use standard semantic HTML sections inside custom responsive wrappers.
Inject the google fonts Outfit and Manrope in the main document/index file.
